name: Arizuki Ui
source:
[url=/c4857]Shiina[/url]'s older sister.
Ui is a second-year high school student who also stays at the dormitory, even though her house is close to the school. Ui is a realist who does not really believe in achieving dreams. She is frugal with her money and works part-time at a family restaurant. Ui used to play lacrosse, but had to stop due to an injury.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kud_Wafter]Wikipedia[/url]]
